# Tender response -- KESKIJKAU-2026-0143

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical property maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA competence certificate for LVI and electrical contracting, valid until 31 March 2027.

3.2 Visakoivu's liability insurance (toiminnan vastuuvakuutus) provides cover of EUR 2,000,000, exceeding the EUR 1,000,000 minimum.

3.3 Visakoivu's equity ratio for FY2025 was 35.2%, exceeding the 20% minimum.

3.4 Visakoivu's turnover exceeds the required threshold.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Corrective maintenance response times: critical faults attended within 4 hours, non-critical within 24 hours, with escalation to a named site supervisor if the target is missed.

4.2 Refrigeration and cooling-plant servicing is carried out by F-gas certified technicians under our current F-kaasu qualification, with logged leak checks per statutory intervals.

4.3 Subcontracting is governed by a written management plan: approved subcontractor list, insurance and qualification checks before engagement, and Visakoivu's own site supervisor retaining responsibility for quality and schedule.

4.4 The full asset register and maintenance documentation will be handed over to the City in an agreed digital format at contract end, or at any point the City requests during the term.

4.5 Proposed SLA targets: 95% of critical faults resolved within the response window; monthly reporting against target with root-cause notes on any miss.

4.6 New or modified plant is commissioned against a written test protocol, witnessed by the City's property management unit before handover.

4.7 Condition-monitoring data (inspection rounds, meter readings, fault logs) is collected on our maintenance management system and exportable to the City on request.

4.8 All technicians deployed hold the qualifications required for their trade (LVI, electrical, refrigeration) and carry them on site.

4.9 Our staff follow the City's access-control and site-security procedures at each property, including sign-in and identification badges.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Pricing is quoted in EUR.

5.2 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency where subcontracted work forms part of an invoice.

5.3 A cost breakdown is provided per the required format.

5.4 We accept a contractual penalty where agreed service levels are not met, calculated against the affected call-off order value.

## 6. Forms and attachments

6.1 CVs of key personnel are enclosed.

6.2 An extract from the Trade Register is enclosed.

## 7. Submission format

7.1 Maintenance pricing is quoted per property.

7.2 All prices are rounded to two decimal places.

7.3 The framework pricing reference currency is EUR.

7.4 This tender is submitted before the deadline of 19 October 2026, 12:00 EET.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.2 Unresolved faults are escalated to a named supervisor after 24 hours and to management after 48 hours, with the City notified at each stage.

2.3 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, with documented checks after each maintenance visit.

2.4 A preventive maintenance plan is prepared per property in the first quarter of the contract, covering all building services in scope.

3.2 Visakoivu operates round-the-clock (24/7) fault-response duty within Finland as an established part of its public-sector maintenance work, including the current framework covering five terveysasemat for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue (REF02) and the school-property framework for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki (REF05). This standby arrangement will be extended to cover this framework agreement.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 The applicable retention percentage is confirmed in the pricing schedule.

2.1 A description of our quality management system (NMSB 7310:2015) is enclosed.

2.2 This tender is submitted using the required tender form (Liite 1), completed in full.
